name: cavemio-referral
title: Referral
description: A referral pass that fills as friends join: their faces fly up into its notches, and the last one turns the track into Claim.

cavemio.accessibility:
- The email field is the Tag input: paste lists, Backspace to edit the last chip, errors read with each chip.
- Friends who join and invites that are sent are announced from a status region; the count is read as a whole number.
- The flying face is a copy laid over the block and removed when it lands; the real notch is what stays, so nothing moves under a reader’s focus.
- The notches are presentation; the heading says how many friends are left, and Claim is a real button that only takes focus once unlocked.
- Its light comes from your theme: the pass mixes --primary-foreground into --primary, friends take tints from --chart-1 to --chart-5, and the link’s inset is a 1px edge. No drop shadows, glow or blur.
- Built from Tag input, Copy button, Number roll, Status button and Text morph, which the CLI installs with it. No animation library; with reduced motion notches light in place and nothing flies.
cavemio.previewNote: Interactive local fixture. Data and async results are simulated in the preview; the caller supplies application services.

props.name: link
props.description: – · The person’s invite link, shown inset with Copy.

props.name: friends
props.description: – · Newest first: { id, email, name?, status: "invited" | "joined" }. A status turning joined is what flies a face to the pass.

props.name: goal
props.description: – · Friends needed for the reward; one notch each.

props.name: reward / offer
props.description: – · What they get (“a free month of Pro”) and what friends get, under the link.

props.name: onInvite
props.description: – · Send the invites and add them to friends; throw an Error to keep the chips and show why.

props.name: onClaim
props.description: – · Give the reward once the goal is reached.

props.name: claimed
props.description: – · Already claimed (from your data); otherwise it follows onClaim.

features.title: A pass with a notch per friend
features.description: goal sets the notches; each joined friend fills one with their initials, in the order they joined.

features.title: Joining you can see
features.description: When a friend’s status turns joined, their face flies from their row to their notch, which lights as it lands.

features.title: Invites as chips
features.description: Paste a list or type addresses; wrong ones and people already invited are caught before sending.

features.title: Unlock in place
features.description: At the goal the notches close in and become Claim; onClaim goes Claiming → Claimed.

features.title: Your link, one tap
features.description: The link sits inset in the pass with a Copy button that confirms in place.

features.title: Your database decides
features.description: friends and their status are props; onInvite and onClaim throw your message and it shows where it happened.

states.title: pass
states.description: The lit pass: “2 more friends and you get a free month”, a track of notches (lit ones carry initials, joined by lit fine lines), and the link inset with Copy.

states.title: invite
states.description: Addresses become chips in the tag input; invalid or already invited ones are marked. Send invite(s) → Sending → Sent, and the new friends slide into the list as Invited.

states.title: joined
states.description: A friend’s face lifts from their row in an arc (820ms, rising and growing then settling to the notch’s size); the notch lights as it lands, “Invited” morphs to “Joined” with a check folding in, and the count rolls.

states.title: unlocked
states.description: At the goal the notches slide toward the middle and fade while the Claim button opens out of the centre (a 560ms clip), and the heading morphs to “You unlocked it”.

states.title: claimed
states.description: Claim → Claiming → Claimed with a drawn check; the heading says Reward claimed.

states.title: error
states.description: If onInvite throws, the button shakes into Try again, the chips stay and your message replaces the hint.
